Browse the palettes

Source: vignettes/articles/browse.Rmd
browse.Rmd

Every palette in transformerpalettes, with its colours, where it came from, and the toy photo, episode still or comic panel it was checked against. Most characters have a toy palette and a cartoon palette; a few have a comic one too. Filter by medium, faction, combiner team, role or what kind of plot the palette suits, click a swatch to copy its hex code, and use Suggest a change on any card to open a prefilled GitHub issue where you can propose different colours or attach a better photograph. Missing someone? Request a character.

Suggesting changes

Every palette here is an approximation read off toy photographs, so corrections are welcome. Each card links to a prefilled GitHub issue form:

  • Suggest a change if a colour is wrong, missing, or should be removed, or if the description, alternate mode, year or reference image is off. Say which hex codes you would add, change or drop and why. For a toy palette a photo under neutral light is the best evidence; for a cartoon palette a clean episode still; for a comic palette the issue and page.
  • Ask for a cartoon or comic version of a character that only has a toy palette by using Suggest a change on the toy card and picking “Add a cartoon or comic version” as the kind of change. Comic palettes are added a team at a time from specific Marvel issues, so say which issue you have in mind.
  • Request a character if a Transformer or team you care about is not covered yet. The wishlist shows what is already queued.

You need a GitHub account to open an issue. If you would rather not, email the maintainer listed in the package DESCRIPTION.
